reason: This text, from Joshua 6, describes the fall of Jericho. It contains instructions from God to Joshua, Joshua's commands to the priests and people regarding circumambulation of the city and trumpet-blowing, and the successful execution of these instructions. The people obey Joshua's directive that they remain silent and do not shout until commanded (v. 10: 'לא תָרִיעוּ וְלֹֽא־ תַשְׁמִיעוּ אֶת־ קוֹלְכֶם'). The walls fall and the city is taken. No Hebrew leader expresses complaint or dissatisfaction with the people; rather, the people comply fully with all commands given to them.
